# TASK-021 Report job cadence

Status: cadence decided; implementation pending

Outcome: the report job runs on the cadence set by the ruling cited below.

## Ruling reference

Handed over by the planning agent.

Reference
  Binding        mira
  Repository     example/mira-decisions
  ADR            0002
  Path           docs/adr/0002-reports-go-out-weekly.md
  Commit         1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c
  Digest         sha256:aea104d89bfefcc20ddc7fc7f60dd30e6ec3b20116f46fbde8b28e8997782b06

## Cadence decision

Chosen cadence: `daily`. Follow the ruling in force, ADR 0023, for the
schedule. This task records the choice only; feature implementation is pending.

The original ADR 0002 reference above was read at the cited commit and its
computed digest matches the cited digest. Its status is `Superseded by 0014`;
ADR 0014 at that same commit is `Superseded by 0023`. ADR 0023 is `Accepted`
both at that commit and at the decision repository's current HEAD (the same
commit). The chain therefore ends at ADR 0023, the ruling in force.

Effective ruling reference (schedule details live here):

Reference
  Binding        mira
  Repository     example/mira-decisions
  ADR            0023
  Path           docs/adr/0023-reports-go-out-daily-at-07-00.md
  Commit         1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c
  Digest         sha256:bea52c60547bd724a259f12e94614147bafc87856a3a4f0a9e28c339e0ce7366

The effective ruling's digest differs from the original cited digest because
it identifies ADR 0023 rather than ADR 0002.
